dispositions.rationale: The reviewer confirms this is not blocking: the atomic uniqueness guard prevents corruption and the canonical zip cleanup avoids orphaned blobs. Using getPet for the cheap precheck only changes which layer rejects a duplicate unlisted slug, not correctness.
dispositions.observation: `convex/actions/uploadPet.ts:51-55` now uses `api.pets.getPet` for the duplicate-slug precheck. Because `getPet` hides unlisted rows, an upload reusing an unlisted slug will miss the cheap precheck and fail later in `createPet` instead. The atomic uniqueness guard still prevents corruption, and the canonical zip cleanup path avoids orphaning the new blob, so this is not a blocking bug for this ticket.
